command:
set -u
printf 'HOST='; hostname
printf 'PUBLIC_HINT='; hostname -f 2>/dev/null || true
printf '
LISTENERS
'; ss -lnt 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,40p'
printf '
INGRESS_BINARIES
'; for x in caddy nginx apache2 cloudflared traefik; do command -v "$x" 2>/dev/null && echo "$x=present"; done
printf '
SYSTEM_UNITS
'; systemctl --no-pager --type=service --state=running 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'caddy|nginx|cloudflared|traefik|omega|bridge' | head -30 || true
